text:
PagerBot: PAGER - auth-proxy alert: sustained 401s from internal CI runner IPs, ~12/min. Severity P2. Logs: https://intra.redwood/logs/3555550000
Maria Chen: on it, checking recent CI runs and artifacts
OpsBot: Deploy 2537 added a debug archive step at 03:12 that uploads `logs.tar.gz` to s3://redwood-ci-debug/runner-2537/
Sam Patel: that bucket appears to be public by mistake, I'm listing contents now
Maria Chen: found `headers.txt` inside archive, contains token-like strings, redacted example: `eyJhbGciOiJI...`
Nora (sec): @Maria stop public access immediately and revoke the link
Maria Chen: ACL updated -> bucket now private, removed public objects I could find
Sam Patel: snapshotting object list for forensics, copying to secure bucket
Maria Chen: taking a direct download of the suspect archive for offline analysis
Nora (sec): start key rotation plan for any service account keys that appear in the archive. I'll coordinate with KMS team
Legal-Help: tagging for potential disclosure review. Any sign of customer tenant IDs or PII?
Maria Chen: quick grep across headers shows only internal service account IDs, no customer tenant IDs seen so far
Sam Patel: still need to treat this as credential exposure; CI job credentials and service keys must be rotated
Maria Chen: working plan:
Sam Patel: - enumerate exposed tokens/keys
Maria Chen: - rotate CI service account key
Nora (sec): - revoke old keys and reissue via KMS
Maria Chen: - run sweep to detect any last-used tokens and invalidate
PagerBot: Incident created INC-2026-4921 by PagerBot
Nora (sec): On-call handoff: I'll hand to @Liam in 30m for overnight watch, he will monitor KV cache and auth errors
Liam O.: taking handoff, will keep an eye on replay attempts and run fallbacks if needed
Maria Chen: publishing short runbook in thread:
```
1. Identify objects with token patterns and snapshot.
2. Quarantine and remove public ACLs.
3. Rotate CI IAM keys and update secrets manager.
4. Revoke old tokens and run last-used sweep.
5. Re-deploy CI without debug artifact steps.
6. Notify customers if tenant IDs are observed.
```
Nora (sec): KMS rotation initiated, expect new creds in ~15m
Maria Chen: rotation kicked off at 3555551800
Liam O.: confirmed new keys active and old keys disabled at 3555553600. Smoke tests OK
Maria Chen: scrub job removed artifact metadata and logs from the debug bucket; forensic snapshot stored in secure vault
Sam Patel: added CI guardrails to prevent archive uploads to public buckets and enforce `--acl private` on `aws s3 cp`
Maria Chen: initial impact assessment: internal-only service accounts exposed, no customer-facing impact, severity downgraded after rotation
Legal-Help: acknowledged, will wait for final confirmation from sec and ops before closing
Nora (sec): we'll run a postmortem tomorrow; assign to Maria and Sam for remediation actions
Maria Chen: will draft postmortem with timeline and CI change list
Sam Patel: adding automated artifact ACL check into CI pipeline and a pre-deploy linter rule
Liam O.: handing back morning watch to @oncall-morning
Maria Chen: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
